dct_description_sm: The objective of this study was to determine whether peritoneal dialysis (PD) catheter insertion decreases the time to achieve a negative 24 hour post-operative fluid balance and improve morbidity in neonates with hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS) or its variants who undergo a Norwood procedure.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Prophylactic Peritoneal Dialysis Decreases Time to Achieve a Negative Fluid Balance After the Norwood Procedure
